meaning: to create (a song, story, artwork); a creative work

senses.en: to create (a song, story, artwork); a creative work

examples.zh: 他一直在创作新歌。
examples.en: He has been writing new songs.

examples.zh: 这部电影是他自己创作的。
examples.en: He created this film himself.

examples.zh: 这位作家每天早上创作三个小时。
examples.en: This writer works on his writing for three hours every morning.

meaning: brand; a sign or plate

senses.en: brand; a sign or plate

note: In speech 牌子 is the everyday word for a brand: 什么牌子的?

examples.zh: 这个牌子的手机很便宜。
examples.en: This brand of phone is very cheap.

examples.zh: 门口挂着一块牌子，写着“请安静”。
examples.en: A sign hangs at the door that says "Please be quiet".

examples.zh: 这个牌子的衣服很好看。
examples.en: Clothes of this brand look great.

meaning: hygiene; hygienic, clean

senses.en: hygiene; hygienic, clean

examples.zh: 饭馆的卫生很重要。
examples.en: Hygiene in a restaurant is very important.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆不太卫生，我们换一家吧。
examples.en: This restaurant isn't very clean. Let's go to another one.

examples.zh: 吃饭前要洗手，注意卫生。
examples.en: Wash your hands before eating and pay attention to hygiene.

meaning: to open (to the public); to bloom

senses.en: to open (to the public); to bloom

examples.zh: 公园每天早上六点开放。
examples.en: The park opens at six every morning.

examples.zh: 这个公园周末不开放。
examples.en: This park is not open on weekends.

examples.zh: 春天到了，花都开放了。
examples.en: Spring has come and the flowers are all in bloom.

meaning: to point out; to indicate

senses.en: to point out; to indicate

examples.zh: 老师指出了我作业里的错误。
examples.en: The teacher pointed out the mistakes in my homework.

examples.zh: 谢谢你指出我的问题。
examples.en: Thank you for pointing out my problem.

examples.zh: 他指出，这个方法不太安全。
examples.en: He pointed out that this method is not very safe.

meaning: civilization; civilized, polite in public behavior

senses.en: civilization; civilized, polite in public behavior

examples.zh: 这座城市有两千年的文明。
examples.en: This city has two thousand years of civilization.

examples.zh: 大家要做文明的游客，不要乱放东西。
examples.en: Everyone should be a considerate tourist and not leave things lying around.

examples.zh: 他说话很文明，对人很好。
examples.en: He speaks politely and is kind to people.

meaning: in the past; once upon a time

senses.en: in the past; once upon a time

examples.zh: 从前这里没有地铁。
examples.en: There used to be no subway here.

examples.zh: 他比从前高多了。
examples.en: He is much taller than before.

examples.zh: 从前，山里住着一位老人。
examples.en: Once upon a time, an old man lived in the mountains.

meaning: to broadcast; to air (a TV or radio program)

senses.en: to broadcast; to air (a TV or radio program)

examples.zh: 这部电视剧明天晚上八点播出。
examples.en: This TV series airs tomorrow evening at eight.

examples.zh: 比赛会在电视上播出吗？
examples.en: Will the game be broadcast on TV?

examples.zh: 这个节目已经播出三年了。
examples.en: This program has been on the air for three years.

meaning: high-speed; expressway (short for 高速公路)

senses.en: high-speed; expressway (short for 高速公路)

note: 走高速 means take the expressway.

examples.zh: 去机场走高速比较快。
examples.en: Taking the expressway to the airport is faster.

examples.zh: 高速上车很多，开车要小心。
examples.en: There are lots of cars on the expressway, so drive carefully.

examples.zh: 这条路是高速，不能停车。
examples.en: This road is an expressway; you can't park.

meaning: determination; to be determined, to make up one's mind

senses.en: determination; to be determined, to make up one's mind

note: Common: 下决心 (make up one's mind).

examples.zh: 我决心明年学好汉语。
examples.en: I am determined to learn Chinese well next year.

examples.zh: 他下了很大的决心，要去中国工作。
examples.en: He made up his mind firmly to go and work in China.

examples.zh: 你真的决心搬家了吗？
examples.en: Have you really made up your mind to move?

meaning: cola

senses.en: cola

examples.zh: 我想喝一杯可乐。
examples.en: I'd like a glass of cola.

examples.zh: 你要可乐还是茶？
examples.en: Do you want cola or tea?

examples.zh: 孩子们都爱喝可乐，但对身体不好。
examples.en: Kids all love cola, but it is bad for health.

meaning: to spread; to disseminate

senses.en: to spread; to disseminate

examples.zh: 这种病可以通过空气传播。
examples.en: This disease can spread through the air.

examples.zh: 好消息传播得很快。
examples.en: Good news spreads fast.

examples.zh: 手机让消息传播得更快。
examples.en: Mobile phones make news spread even faster.

meaning: to be engaged in; to work in (a field)

senses.en: to be engaged in; to work in (a field)

note: Followed by a field or line of work: 从事教育, 从事医疗.

examples.zh: 他从事教育工作十年了。
examples.en: He has worked in education for ten years.

examples.zh: 你从事什么工作？
examples.en: What kind of work do you do?

examples.zh: 她想从事医生的工作。
examples.en: She wants to work as a doctor.

meaning: banana

senses.en: banana

examples.zh: 我早饭吃了一个香蕉。
examples.en: I had a banana for breakfast.

examples.zh: 这个香蕉太大了，我吃不完。
examples.en: This banana is too big; I can't finish it.

examples.zh: 请帮我买几个香蕉。
examples.en: Please buy me a few bananas.

meaning: all parts of the country; various places

senses.en: all parts of the country; various places

examples.zh: 来自各地的游客都很喜欢这里。
examples.en: Tourists from all over like it here.

examples.zh: 各地的菜味道都不同。
examples.en: The food tastes different in each region.

examples.zh: 春节的时候，各地都很漂亮。
examples.en: At Spring Festival, every place looks beautiful.

meaning: to welcome; to greet (someone arriving, an event)

senses.en: to welcome; to greet (someone arriving, an event)

examples.zh: 我们去机场迎接客人。
examples.en: We are going to the airport to meet our guests.

examples.zh: 大家都在准备迎接新年。
examples.en: Everyone is getting ready to welcome the New Year.

examples.zh: 学生们站在门口迎接校长。
examples.en: The students stood at the door to welcome the principal.

meaning: long-term; over a long period

senses.en: long-term; over a long period

examples.zh: 他长期在国外工作。
examples.en: He has worked abroad for a long time.

examples.zh: 这种药不能长期吃。
examples.en: You can't take this medicine long-term.

examples.zh: 我想找一份长期的工作。
examples.en: I want to find a long-term job.

meaning: member (of a club, store, or service)

senses.en: member (of a club, store, or service)

examples.zh: 这家商店的会员可以便宜一点儿。
examples.en: Members of this store get things a bit cheaper.

examples.zh: 我想办一张会员卡。
examples.en: I'd like to get a membership card.

examples.zh: 成为会员以后，可以在这里停车。
examples.en: After becoming a member, you can park here.

meaning: to write (as a craft); writing

senses.en: to write (as a craft); writing

note: Means the activity of writing, not writing a single note or message.

examples.zh: 他每天晚上都用两个小时写作。
examples.en: He spends two hours writing every evening.

examples.zh: 我的汉语写作还不太好。
examples.en: My Chinese writing still isn't very good.

examples.zh: 老师让我们多读书，多写作。
examples.en: The teacher told us to read more and write more.

meaning: TV series; TV drama

senses.en: TV series; TV drama

examples.zh: 这部电视剧你看了吗？
examples.en: Have you watched this TV series?

examples.zh: 我妈妈每天晚上都看电视剧。
examples.en: My mom watches TV dramas every evening.

examples.zh: 看电视剧能帮助我学汉语。
examples.en: Watching TV series helps me learn Chinese.
